history_note: This machine-readable history was introduced in 0.3.0. Earlier entries summarize retained human changelog and release metadata, not a pre-existing machine ledger.

changes: Four separate iterations with a maintained local Lily actor; Red's legacy courier and core remain preserved alongside an optional reliability companion.
Versioned prewrite refusals retain not_sent and registered error codes; legacy, malformed and unknown errors remain uncertain.
Ordinary sends retain original observation guards; an explicit lok_retreat_v1 decision permits at most one guarded write attempt of flee after a bounded combat predicate, with separate AFK opt-in.
Original decision, lease epoch, deadline, predicate evidence and intervening colored observations are preserved; admitted IDs cannot be repurposed or replay uncertain actions.
Maintained actor and helper improve incremental observation handling and bounded scene evidence; unsupported text remains unknown.
Muse adds a sixth scoped operation and typed refusal handling without changing credential or network scope.
Declared component version reports distinguish package metadata from installed or running state; older updater manifest compatibility and deliberate downloads remain intact.
Current Windows validation is recorded separately; historical receipts, Red originals and private runtime state remain preserved.

changes: Separate same-interpreter launcher and standard-library GitLab checker; automatic checks notify only.
Explicit archive downloads verify release-specific metadata, selected iteration, exact size and SHA-256; no automatic extraction or execution.
Installation remains an operator-requested side-by-side procedure; no restart, session control, game connection or request replay.
External per-install cache and 24-hour throttle; stderr notices preserve client stdout; no Git watcher, scheduler or background service.
Human and machine update instructions, independent updater evidence, exact distribution manifests and external standalone packages.
Exact 0.2.1 metadata retained; existing runtime source, authored nested trees, dependency pins and historical test/validation files preserved.
